claude_proposed_widenings.name: spell_cast_option
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Overchannel fires as a choice made at spell-cast time, not as a standalone activation. No class feature family models 'when you cast a qualifying spell, you may invoke this to modify the cast outcome.' The activation family assumes activate → immediate effect; Overchannel requires a spell_cast_window trigger with a conditional-invoke pattern.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When you cast a Wizard spell with a spell slot of levels 1–5 that deals damage, you can deal maximum damage with that spell on the turn you cast it.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureEffect::modify_roll_substitute (maximize damage)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The core payoff is replacing the spell's damage roll with the maximum possible value. The v4 atom modify_roll_substitute covers this concept but it is not exposed as a ClassFeatureEffect variant. Needs a new variant such as { kind: 'maximize_damage_roll'; scope: 'triggering_spell' }.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can deal maximum damage with that spell on the turn you cast it

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureEffect::self_damage_consequence
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Repeated use before a Long Rest causes the caster to take Necrotic damage immediately after casting. Self-damage-as-activation-consequence is absent from ClassFeatureEffect. Needs a variant such as { kind: 'self_damage'; damageType: DamageType; amount: DiceAmount; bypassesResistanceAndImmunity: true }.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you take 2d12 Necrotic damage for each level of the spell slot immediately after you cast it. This damage ignores Resistance and Immunity.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: LevelAxis::use_count_before_long_rest
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The escalating penalty scales with the number of times the feature has been used within the current Long Rest window. LevelAxis has no variant for 'use count since last Long Rest.' Needs e.g. axis: 'use_count_before_long_rest' so DiceAmount linear_per_level can express +1d12/level per additional use.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Each time you use this feature again before finishing a Long Rest, the Necrotic damage per spell level increases by 1d12.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureActivationCost or trigger filter: qualifying_spell_cast
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The scope of Overchannel is restricted to Wizard spells using levels 1–5 slots that deal damage. There is no 'qualifying spell cast' trigger/filter in the class-feature surface — the activation family has no way to express a conditional trigger rooted in a spell_cast_window.
